text:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke: v2026.04.10-canary finished. Smoke set: warmup-heartbeat, kv-prefill, embed-latency. Observed 5/120 failing probes (4.2%) — intermittent 503s from warmup-heartbeat and kv-prefill 429s.

nikhil: I see a small 503 tail in the synth dashboard and a couple of node restarts around the same time.

synth-watchdog: failing hosts: eu-w2-gpu-11, eu-w2-gpu-14. Logs: "kv_cache: warmup timed out after 300ms" and kubelet: "container restarted (OOMKilled)" once.

tanya: this is the new prefill shadowing flag behavior in rc build. Could be increased memory pressure during simultaneous prefill + warmup.

oncall: pulling pod events now. running: `kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector involvedObject.name=eu-w2-gpu-11 -o wide | tail -n 50`

oncall: quick paste: events show repeated restart cycles on prefill-worker; memory spike to 1.8Gi then restart.

nikhil: decision: do we 1) pause canary and pin affected nodes to stable image, 2) reduce canary to 1% and disable prefill-shadow on canary, or 3) full rollback?

release-manager: recommended: reduce canary to 1% and flip prefill-shadow off for canary only, keep rollout moving but reduce impact. We'll update release notes.

tanya: agreed. command to run: `deploy-bot modify-rollout --model rwd-embed-lite --canary 1 --flag prefill-shadow=false --note "temporary disable prefill-shadow on canary due to prefills causing OOM on subset"`

deploy-bot: Executing command... Completed. Estimated normalization 90s.

synth-watchdog: scheduled targeted recheck in 2m.

(2m later)
synth-watchdog: recheck: failing probes down to 0/120, kv-prefill 429s at 0.04%, warmup-heartbeat p95 back to baseline.

oncall: monitoring for 45m; alert threshold set: prefills_429 > 0.5% for 5m -> pager.

release-manager: note for changelog: "Canary adjusted: prefill-shadow disabled and canary reduced to 1% after transient prefills/oom on a subset of nodes. No rollback required. Investigating memory pressure under concurrent prefill+warmup."

nikhil: creating ticket RW-1567 with heap profiles and pod dumps. Tanya/infra to run a repro with prefill-load x3.

tanya: will run repro and post results. Thanks team.
